turkish.english: When it was raining, I didn't want to go outside.
turkish.grammar: 'Yağmur': the suffix chain on this verb encodes tense, person, and number in one word.

turkish.target: Sonuç olarak, daha çok çalışmamız gerekiyor.
turkish.english: In conclusion, we need to work harder.
turkish.grammar: 'gerekiyor': the suffix chain on this verb encodes tense, person, and number in one word.

turkish.target: Yazar dün akşam tuzlu çorba ormanda tamir etti.
turkish.english: The writer sewed salty soup in the forest last night.
turkish.grammar: 'Yazar': the suffix chain on this verb encodes tense, person, and number in one word.

turkish.target: Komşu kadın yaz tatilinde fırın önünde arkadaşlarıyla sohbet ediyordu.
turkish.english: The neighbor woman was chatting with friends in front of the bakery during summer vacation.
turkish.grammar: 'kadın': the suffix chain on this verb encodes tense, person, and number in one word.

turkish.target: Başka bir deyişle, böyle devam edemeyiz.
turkish.english: In other words, we cannot continue like this.
turkish.grammar: 'bir': the suffix chain on this verb encodes tense, person, and number in one word.

turkish.target: Müdür her pazar ağır otobüs spor salonunda gitti.
turkish.english: The director bought heavy a bus at the gym every Sunday.
turkish.grammar: 'Müdür': the suffix chain on this verb encodes tense, person, and number in one word.

turkish.target: Sonuç olarak birçok aile taşınmak zorunda kaldı.
turkish.english: As a result, many families had to move.
turkish.grammar: 'kaldı': the suffix chain on this verb encodes tense, person, and number in one word.

turkish.target: Yaşlandıkça insan hayata farklı bir gözle bakmaya başlıyor.
turkish.english: As one grows older, one starts to look at life with different eyes.
turkish.grammar: -dıkça = as/the more...

russian.target: Большое спасибо за вашу помощь, это очень важно.
russian.english: Thank you very much for your help, it is very important.
russian.grammar: Большое спасибо = many thanks. За + accusative: за вашу помощь = for your help. This is the standard gratitude formula.
